manifest.selection_policy: All declared baselines are reported; no baseline is selected using test metrics.
manifest.transform_policy: No imputation, interpolation, forward fill or target-derived feature is permitted.
manifest.weather_policy: Weather-augmented climatology is unavailable unless finite captured weather features exist; no ERA5/CAMS/assumed fallback is used.

purpose: Phase 8 reproducible chronological PM2.5 baselines; no operational forecast claim
